newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PAL Q4 net loss widens to 1.41 bln pesos.
newsitem.headline: PAL Q4 net loss widens to 1.41 bln pesos.

text.p: Philippine Airlines (PAL) posted a net loss of 1.41 billion pesos in the fourth quarter of the year, ending March 31, compared to a 1.2 billion loss in the third quarter, PAL's unaudited financial statement showed on Tuesday.
It did not give its full-year figures, but PAL chief finance officer Jaime Bautista earlier said it was expecting a two billion peso loss in the 1996/97 year.
In a report submitted to the Securities and Exchange Commission, PAL blamed the net loss on higher operating expenses which reached 8.87 billion pesos during the period.
"The increase in operating expenses was mainly due to higher flying operations expenses, passenger service expenses, and lease charges," the company said.
"This, coupled with higher non-operating expenses, resulted in a higher net loss for the current quarter," it added.
Revenues totalled 7.91 billion pesos, of which passengers accounted for 6.32 billion and cargo 862.11 million.
